dex_entry.text:
Sleeps 18 hours a
day. If it senses
danger, it will teleport itself to
safety even as it
sleeps.

A savage POKéMON
that died out in
ancient times. It was resurrected
using DNA taken
from amber.

A POKéMON that can
memorize anything.
It never forgets what it learns--
that's why this
POKéMON is smart.

The frightening
patterns on its
belly have been studied. Six
variations have
been confirmed.

A legendary POKé-
MON in China.
Many people are charmed by its
grace and beauty
while running.

A legendary bird
POKéMON. It
freezes water that is contained
in winter air and
makes it snow.

It has 3 poisonous
stingers on its
forelegs and its tail. They are
used to jab its
enemy repeatedly.

Prefers hot and
humid places.
It ensnares tiny insects with its
vines and devours
them.

Once it takes aim
at its enemy, it
blasts out water with even more
force than a fire
hose.

It can go for days
without eating a
single morsel. In the bulb on
its back, it
stores energy.

Its wings, covered
with poisonous
powders, repel water. This
allows it to fly
in the rain.

If you touch the
feeler on top of
its head, it will release a horrible
stink to protect
itself.

A gentle and kind-
hearted POKéMON
that shares its nutritious eggs
if it sees an
injured POKéMON.

When expelling a
blast of super
hot fire, the red flame at the tip
of its tail burns
more intensely.

The flame at the
tip of its tail
makes a sound as it burns. You can
only hear it in
quiet places.

Tough fights could
excite this
POKéMON. When excited, it may
blow out bluish-
white flames.

They appear to be
very protective of
their own world. It is a kind of
fairy, rarely seen
by people.

Adored for their
cute looks and
playfulness. They are thought to be
rare, as they do
not appear often.

For protection, it
uses its harder-
than-diamonds shell. It also
shoots spikes from
the shell.

Wears the skull
of its deceased
mother. Its cries echo inside the
skull and come out
as a sad melody.

Its entire body is
a snowy-white.
Unharmed by even intense cold, it
swims powerfully
in icy waters.

It prefers dark
places. It spends
most of its time underground,
though it may pop
up in caves.

When it spots an
enemy, its body
transfigures into an almost perfect
copy of its oppo-
nent.

One of DODUO's 2
heads splits to
form a unique species. It runs
close to 40 MPH
in prairies.

Its short wings
make flying dif-
ficult. Instead, this POKéMON runs
at high speed on
developed legs.

According to a
witness, its body
was surrounded by a strange aura
that gave it a
mystical look.

It is said that
this POKéMON lives
somewhere in the sea and that it
flies. However, it
is only a rumor.

The existence of
this mythical
POKéMON was only recently confirmed
by a fisherman
who caught one.

If you sleep by
it all the time,
it will sometimes show you dreams
it has eaten in
the past.

A team of triplets
that can burrow
over 60 MPH. Due to this, some
people think it's
an earthquake.

Its genetic code
is unstable, so it
could evolve in a variety of ways.
There are only a
few alive.

The older it gets,
the longer it
grows. At night, it wraps its long
body around tree
branches to rest.

If a major power
outage occurs, it
is certain that this POKéMON has
eaten electricity
at a power plant.

Stores electrical
energy inside its
body. Even the slightest shock
could trigger a
huge explosion.

The heads attract
each other and
spin around. There must be 6
heads for it to
maintain balance.

Its cries are very
noisy. This is
because each of the 3 heads thinks
about whatever it
likes.

Lives where reedy
plants grow. They
are rarely seen, so it's thought
their numbers are
decreasing.

A POKéMON that
dates back many
years. If it senses danger, it
flies high and
away, instantly.

It has a flame
chamber inside its
body. It inhales, then blows out
fire that is over
3,000F degrees.

Said to appear in
decrepit, deserted
buildings. It has no real shape as
it appears to be
made of a gas.

A GENGAR is close
by if you feel a
sudden chill. It may be trying
to lay a curse
on you.

Commonly found
near mountain
trails, etc. If you step on
one by accident,
it gets angry.

Smells incredibly
foul! However,
around 1 out of 1,000 people enjoy
sniffing its nose-
bending stink.

It attacks in a
stealthy manner,
without warning. Its sharp fangs
are used to bite
and suck blood.

When it is time
for them to lay
eggs, they can be seen swimming up
rivers and falls
in large groups.

Its slim and long
limbs end in broad
flippers. They are used for swim-
ming gracefully
in lakes.

Once it sheds its
skin, its body
turns tender and whitish. Its hide
hardens when it's
exposed to air.

Often seen rolling
down mountain
trails. Obstacles are just things to
roll straight
over, not avoid.

Made of hardened
sludge. It smells
too putrid to touch.
Even weeds won't
grow in its path.

A POKéMON with a
friendly nature.
However, it will bark fiercely at
anything invading
its territory.

Brutally vicious
and enormously
destructive. Known for totally
destroying cities
in ancient times.

By licking, it
saps the victim's
life. It causes shaking that won't
stop until the
victim's demise.

Punches in cork-
screw fashion. It
can punch its way through a concrete
wall in the same
way as a drill.

When kicking, the
sole of its foot
turns as hard as a diamond on im-
pact and destroys
its enemy.

If it senses any
danger, it will
vigorously spray water or a special
type of ink from
its mouth.

Avoid eye contact
if you come across
one. It will try to put you to
sleep by using
its pendulum.

The bulb on its
back grows by
drawing energy. It gives off an
aroma when it is
ready to bloom.

Uses its alluring
eyes to enrapture
its foe. It then sings a pleasing
melody that lulls
the foe to sleep.

A sensitive POKé-
MON that easily
becomes sad or angry. Every time
its mood changes,
it charges power.

Appears to move
to a rhythm of
its own, as if it were dancing. It
wiggles its hips
as it walks.

A POKéMON that was
recovered from a
fossil. It uses the eyes on its
back while hiding
on the sea floor.

A slim and fast
swimmer. It slices
its prey with its sharp sickles and
drinks the body
fluids.

Many odd things
happen if this
POKéMON is close by. For example,
it makes clocks
run backwards.

Able to move only
slightly. When
endangered, it may stick out its
stinger and poison
its enemy.

Raises its young
in its belly
pouch. Won't run from any fight
to keep its young
protected.

One claw grew
massively and as
hard as steel. It has 10,000-HP
strength. However,
it is too heavy.

In hot places, its
internal gases
could expand and explode without
any warning. Be
very careful!

Its pincers are
superb weapons.
They sometimes break off during
battle, but they
grow back fast.

A gentle soul that
can read the minds
of people. It can ferry people
across the sea on
its back.

Its tongue spans
almost 7 feet and
moves more freely than its forelegs.
Its licks can
cause paralysis.

One arm alone can
move mountains.
Using all four arms, this POKéMON
fires off awesome
punches.

The belt around
its waist holds
back its energy. Without it, this
POKéMON would be
unstoppable.

Very powerful in
spite of its small
size. Its mastery of many types of
martial arts makes
it very tough.

Famous for being
very unreliable.
It can be found swimming in seas,
lakes, rivers and
shallow puddles.

Born in an active
volcano. Its body
is always cloaked in flames, so it
looks like a big
ball of fire.

It is born with
the ability to
defy gravity. It floats in air on
powerful electro-
magnetic waves.

Generates strange
radio signals. It
raises the tem- perature by 3.6F
degrees within
3,300 feet.

An agile POKéMON
that lives in
trees. It angers easily and will
not hesitate to
attack anything.

Small and weak,
this POKéMON is
adept with its bone club. It has
grown more vicious
over the ages.

Appears to be more
active at night.
It loves round and shiny things.
It can't stop from
picking them up.

Hardens its shell
to protect itself.
However, a large impact may cause
it to pop out of
its shell.

When viewed
through a micro-
scope, this POKéMON's short,
fine, delicate
hair can be seen.

Its DNA is almost
the same as MEW's.
However, its size and disposition
are vastly dif-
ferent.

A legendary bird
POKéMON. As it
flaps its flaming wings, even the
night sky will
turn red.

Always practices
its pantomime act.
It makes enemies believe something
exists that
really doesn't.

Smells so awful,
it can cause
fainting. Through degeneration, it
lost its sense of
smell.

Its steel-like
hide adds to its
powerful tackle. Its horns are so
hard, they can
pierce a diamond.

Tough scales cover
the sturdy body
of this POKéMON. It appears that
the scales grow
in cycles.

A mild-mannered
POKéMON that does
not like to fight. Beware, its
small horns
secrete venom.

Its large ears
are always kept
upright. If it senses danger, it
will attack with a
poisonous sting.

When resting deep
in its burrow, its
thorns always retract.
This is proof that
it is relaxed.

Its horns contain
venom. If they
are stabbed into an enemy, the
impact makes the
poison leak out.

According to an
enduring legend,
9 noble saints were united and
reincarnated as
this POKéMON.

It may be mistaken
for a clump of
weeds. If you try to yank it out of
the ground, it
shrieks horribly.

An ancient POKéMON
that was recovered
from a fossil. It swims by cleverly
twisting its 10
tentacles about.

Sharp beaks ring
its mouth. Its
shell was too big for it to move
freely, so it
became extinct.

Burrows at high
speed in search
of food. The tunnels it leaves
are used as homes
by DIGLETTs.

Burrows under the
ground to gnaw on
tree roots. The mushrooms on its
back absorb most
of the nutrition.

The bug host is
drained of energy
by the mushrooms on its back. They
appear to do all
the thinking.

The gem in its
forehead glows on
its own! It walks with all the grace
and elegance of a
proud queen.

This POKéMON flies
at Mach 2 speed,
seeking prey. Its large talons
are feared as
wicked weapons.

This POKéMON is
full of vitality.
It constantly flies around its
large territory in
search of prey.

Very docile. If
attacked, it will
often kick up sand to protect
itself rather
than fight back.

It keeps its tail
raised to monitor
its surroundings. If you yank its
tail, it will try
to bite you.

Grips its prey in
its pincers and
squeezes hard! It can't move if it's
cold, so it lives
in warm places.

The direction of
the spiral on the
belly differs by area. It is more
adept at swimming
than walking.

Under attack, it
uses its belly 
spiral to put the foe to sleep. It
then makes its
escape.

Swims powerfully
using all the
muscles in its body. It can even
overtake champion
swimmers.

Capable of jumping
incredibly high.
Its hooves and sturdy legs absorb
the impact of a
hard landing.

The only POKéMON
people anticipate
can fly into space. None has
managed the feat
yet, however.

It stops being
angry only when
nobody else is around. To view
this moment is
very difficult.

Always tormented
by headaches.
It uses psychic powers, but it is
not known if it
intends to do so.

When electricity
builds up inside
its body, it becomes feisty.
It also glows in
the dark.

Just loves to run.
If it sees some-
thing faster than itself, it will
give chase at top
speed.

Its hind feet are
webbed. They act
as flippers, so it can swim in
rivers and hunt
for prey.

Will chew on any-
thing with its
fangs. If you see one, it is certain
that 40 more live
in the area.

Walks on its hind
legs. Shows signs
of intelligence. Its armor-like
hide even repels
molten lava.

A POKéMON with a
one-track mind.
Once it charges,  it won't stop
running until it
falls asleep.

Its body is dry.
When it gets cold
at night, its hide is said to
become coated with
a fine dew.

It is skilled at
slashing enemies
with its claws. If broken, they
start to grow back
in a day.

Leaps out of tall
grass and slices
prey with its scythes. The move-
ment looks like
that of a ninja.

Touching the back
fin causes numb-
ness. It hooks its tail to coral
to stay in place
while sleeping.

It is the male's
job to make a
nest by carving out boulders in a
stream using the
horn on its head.

Loves freezing
cold conditions.
Relishes swimming in a frigid cli-
mate of around 14F
degrees.

The shell can
withstand any
attack. However, when it is open,
the tender body
is exposed.

Lives lazily by
the sea. If the
SHELLDER on its tail comes off,
it becomes a
SLOWPOKE again.

Incredibly slow
and sluggish. It
is quite content to loll about
without worrying
about the time.

Will eat anything,
even if the food
happens to be a little moldy. It
never gets an
upset stomach.

Inept at flying
high. However, it
can fly around very fast to
protect its ter-
ritory.

Shoots water at
prey while in the
water. Withdraws into
its shell when in
danger.

The center section
is named the core.
People think it is communicating
when it glows in
7 colors.

As long as the
center section is
unharmed, it can grow back fully
even if it is
chopped to bits.

Its identity is
obscured by masses
of thick, blue vines. The vines
are said to never
stop growing.

A rowdy POKéMON
with a lot of
stamina. Once running, it won't
stop until it hits
something.

It can sometimes
be found all dry
and shriveled up on a beach. Toss
it back into the
sea to revive it.

Its 80 tentacles
can stretch and
contract freely. They wrap around
prey and weaken
it with poison.

Its cell structure
is similar to
water molecules. It will melt away
and become invis-
ible in water.

The powdery scales
on its wings are
hard to remove. They also contain
poison that leaks
out on contact.

Its large eyes act
as radars. In a
bright place, you can see that they
are clusters of
many tiny eyes.

The flower on its
back catches the
sun's rays. The sunlight is
then absorbed and
used for energy.

Lures prey with
the sweet aroma of
honey. Swallowed whole, the prey is
melted in a day,
bones and all.

Flaps its broad
flower petals to
scatter its poisonous pollen.
The flapping sound
is very loud.

It is said to
camouflage itself
as a POKé BALL. It will self-destruct
with very little
stimulus.

Both its fur and
its tails are
beautiful. As it grows, the tails
split and form
more tails.

When tapped, this
POKéMON will pull
in its head, but its tail will
still stick out a
little bit.

Beware of the
sharp stinger on
its head. It hides in grass
and bushes where
it eats leaves.

When hungry, it
swallows anything
that moves. Its hapless prey is
melted inside by
strong acids.

It lives and grows
by absorbing dust,
germs and poison gases that are
contained in toxic
waste and garbage.

Its body is full
of elasticity. By
inhaling deeply, it can continue
to inflate itself
without limit.

This legendary
bird POKéMON is
said to appear when the sky turns
dark and lightning
showers down.

Emits ultrasonic
cries while it
flies. They act as a sonar used
to check for ob-
jects in its way.
